Name: Runescape Spellbook
Author: Tauresium
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JaVonox/Stardew-Spellbook/refs/heads/main/ListingItems/Banner.png[/img]
﻿Guthixian runestones have been found in the depths. These stones, in the hands of a sufficiently experienced wizard, can accomplish incredible feats - instant teleportation, alchemical transformation and, for the more dark-hearted sorcerers, dangerous bolts of pure magical power. Luckily for the aspiring mage, a certain wizard within the valley may be willing to share his knowledge of the arcane with someone he trusts. 

Runescape Spellbook adds 24 spells and a new magic skill, based on the MMO Old School Runescape. These spells, cast using runestones dropped by the monsters of the depths, serve a variety of purposes. Whether you're a farmer, a warrior, a chef or just simply want to make a lot of money, there are spells for you - though you may find you have to hone your magical abilities to access them. With full multiplayer support, you can also master magic alongside others.

﻿[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JaVonox/Stardew-Spellbook/refs/heads/main/ListingItems/Feat.png[/img]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JaVonox/Stardew-Spellbook/refs/heads/main/ListingItems/FAQ.png[/img]

[b]Where can I get runes?[/b]
Runes are mostly dropped by monsters in the mines, skull cavern and volcano. Some runes are contained in geodes or packs which need to be opened first, either using clints geode opening service, a geode crusher or a pack shredder

[b]What do I do with rune packs or geodes?[/b]
Geodes can be opened at Clints or at a geode crusher. Packs can also be opened using the same method but can also be opened using the pack shredder - a machine sold at clint's shop that opens three packs at once in exchange for one coal

[b]How do I unlock magic?[/b]
Reach level 4 friendship with the wizard and enter the farm anytime before noon to unlock spells.

[b]How can I use the Spellbook?[/b]
The spellbook should appear as one of the tabs in your main menu, but pressing J (configurable) while no other menu is open will open the spellbook.

[b]I can't see my Spellbook tab, what should I do?[/b]
In the config there is a setting to move the spellbook to a 'Only Keybind' mode. If you are playing with some mods enabled (Especially any in the section 'Mods with Compatibility Fixes') it is possible that the spellbook tab has been hidden to prevent UI overlap issues - but it should still be accessible via the Keybind. If you wish to show the tab again you can set the config setting to 'Tab and Keybind' and 'LockSpellbookStyle' to true to prevent this from being reset when relaunching the game.

[b]How can I cast combat spells?[/b]
To cast combat spells, you have to first select them in the spellbook. If you have a spell selected, the icon will be under a purple box in the spellbook menu. After this, simply use a battlestaff to cast the spell you've chosen, and the runes will be automatically deducted from your inventory per cast.

[b]Where do I get battlestaves?/I lost my battlestaff, where can I get another?[/b]
Your first battlestaff should come in the mail the day after unlocking magic, but a replacement can be obtained anytime after unlocking magic by checking the adventurers guild store. Stronger staves are found in the rare casket items dropped by various enemies - openable only at Clint's shop.

[b]I found a bug, what should I do?[/b]
Please report any bugs as an issue on my github page, linked below, and I'll get around to fixing them as soon as possible!

If your question doesn't fit any of these, please check the [url=https://github.com/JaVonox/Stardew-Spellbook/wiki]Mod Wiki[/url] or start a discussion thread.
